settingsSubtitle: Manage your account preferences, profile details, and security configurations.
profileInfoDesc: Update your account's profile information and email address.
updatePasswordDesc: Ensure your account is using a long, random password to stay secure.
appearanceSettingsDesc: Customize the theme and visual appearance of your dashboard.
lightModeDesc: Crisp and clear high-contrast light theme
darkModeDesc: Easy on the eyes in low-light environments
systemPrefDesc: Automatically sync with your operating system
twoFactorAuthDesc: Add additional security to your account using two-factor authentication.
twoFactorAuthBody: When two-factor authentication is enabled, you will be prompted for a secure, random token during authentication. You may retrieve this token from your phone's Google Authenticator or 1Password application.
enable2FAModalDesc: To finish enabling two-factor authentication, scan the following QR code using your phone's authenticator application or enter the setup key.
browserSessionsDesc: Manage and log out your active sessions on other browsers and devices.
browserSessionsBody: If necessary, you may log out of all of your other browser sessions across all of your devices. Some of your recent sessions are listed below.
logoutOtherSessionsDesc: Please enter your password to confirm you would like to log out of your other browser sessions across all of your devices.
deleteAccountDesc: Permanently delete your account, teams, and all associated data.
deleteAccountBody: Once your account is deleted, all of its resources and data will be permanently wiped. Before deleting your account, please download any data or information that you wish to retain.
deleteAccountModalDesc: This action cannot be undone. This will permanently delete your account and remove your access across all services.
